summary: The exact candidate fully addresses the three documentation requests: it distinguishes TorchNPU release labels from torch_npu package versions, adds a qualified --disable-cuda-graph fallback for model/operator-specific Ascend capture failures, and documents the existing ModelScope remote and local model path. Independent checks confirmed the base lacked all three elements, the relevant CLI and ModelScope implementation paths exist, and the candidate changes no runtime or native source.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: all three issue-contract additions evaluated false on the exact recorded base. Raw output: /job/base-reproduction.log.
Candidate regression at exact commit: 3 literal documentation assertions passed in 0.43 seconds.
Twelve ModelScope path-resolution cases passed against source imported from /job/repo/python, including disabled mode, cache hits, download fallback, tokenizer paths, and draft models.
The documented fallback flag is registered; help also identifies it as deprecated in favor of phase-specific disabled graph backends.
Attempted MDX/site validation; the fetched mintlify executable could not run due to Permission denied in this image.

gpu_execution_evidence: The assigned accelerator is AMD gfx950 and /dev/davinci* is absent. The candidate is documentation/test-only, and no Ascend NPU execution is claimed.
native_rebuild_evidence: No native source or build configuration changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
remaining_limitations: The reported Ascend graph-capture startup failure could not be reproduced because this host has AMD gfx950 rather than Ascend hardware and lacks CANN and torch_npu.
The original report names no failing model or operator, so model-specific Ascend graph compatibility remains unverified; the candidate correctly limits its claim to troubleshooting guidance.
Mintlify validation was blocked by a non-executable fetched CLI, so no rendered documentation build was obtained.
The ModelScope command was accepted and began downloading, then was terminated to avoid fetching multi-gigabyte weights; no full model download or serving run is claimed.
